headline: You refine frontend experiences through precise corrections, accessible interactions, and pragmatic performance choices.

archetype.name: The Midnight UI Editor
archetype.description: You work in short, concrete rounds: adjust a detail, check the result, then tackle the next rough edge. Your attention moves easily between component APIs, browser behavior, accessibility, and loading performance. You give the assistant room to suggest approaches, but bring your own diagnoses and accept practical fallbacks when an ideal solution becomes costly.

dimensions.title: Small steps, close inspection
dimensions.summary: You build through successive requests and specific feedback, often adding polish once the main fix works. You also accept workable fallbacks when a solution would take more effort than you want to spend immediately.

dimensions.title: Brief and implementation-specific
dimensions.summary: You write concise Traditional Chinese with English technical terms woven in. Your corrections usually identify a concrete mismatch or specify the next change, making short prompts carry substantial implementation detail.

dimensions.title: React frontend with browser instincts
dimensions.summary: Your observed stack includes React Query, Next.js, zod, cva, and Storybook. You work across data fetching, component structure, and rendering behavior, and you contribute browser-specific diagnoses when the assistant's explanation misses the cause.

dimensions.title: Accessible, responsive interfaces
dimensions.summary: You repeatedly attend to contrast, motion preferences, keyboard access, focus behavior, and touch targets. You also care about perceived speed and reusable visual foundations, from loading states to design tokens and font delivery.

dimensions.title: Learn through concrete constraints
dimensions.summary: You use targeted questions and implementation trials to investigate uncertainty about caching and browser behavior. Your prompts suggest a practical learning loop: ask about a specific constraint, try an approach, and revise it against the observed result.

traits.description: You bring accessibility into routine UI work, including labels, motion, contrast, and keyboard focus.

traits.name: Precise feedback, successive polish
traits.description: You steer work with small, explicit adjustments and keep refining after the main behavior is acceptable.

traits.description: You challenge diagnoses and supply concrete browser or rendering details instead of leaving investigation entirely to the assistant.

traits.name: Pragmatic about tradeoffs
traits.description: You accept simpler implementations when a preferred approach becomes blocked or expensive, while keeping the immediate experience moving forward.

traits.description: You care about how quickly an interface feels ready, with attention to loading feedback, animation timing, and font payload.
